what_it_is_about: A periodic effect inhibited for less than one period, under the period policy that executes and resets on reactivation. What is observable is how many times it ticked and when.
execution_order: applied at 0.0 and executed there, because the reference executes a periodic effect on application by default: health 100 -> 95
inhibited at 0.4 and uninhibited at 0.7, each once
read at 2.5: health 80. The same run with nothing ever inhibited answers 85, which is what says the clock and the period were real: three executions there against four here
